name: DHL Supply Chain - DHL Commerce Park DC - St. George SC

fieldNotes.siteIdentity: DHL Commerce Park is a planned 125-acre, three-building, 1.7M sq ft campus near St. George SC serving the Port of Charleston. As of current (2026) imagery only ONE building is built - DHL Commerce Park Building A, 4826 Hwy 78 (~978,805 sq ft, ~74.91-acre parcel per LoopNet/CommercialCafe). The roster's GEOMETRIC_CENTER coord (33.183087,-80.52853) landed ~700 m NE on an unrelated industrial/aggregate yard; corrected to Building A at 33.177800,-80.535000.
fieldNotes.buildingStatus: Building A appears built but largely vacant - the SW dock face shows a long row of EMPTY marked trailer-parking stalls and almost no trailers across the site. LoopNet lists 4826 Hwy 78 as available for lease, consistent with an empty/marketed building. multipleFacilities set false (only one building exists on the developed parcel).
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard-booth checkpoint identified. A single access road runs from Hwy 78 NE into the truck yard; no controlled pinch-point visible. Flagged uncertain - the site is empty so any gate may be open/undeployed, and imagery resolution limits a definitive call.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the entrance or anywhere on the property.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building (~979k sq ft) with continuous dock banks on both the SW and NE long faces. Estimated ~110 doors, banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Marked trailer-parking stalls exist along the SW dock apron but are essentially empty (building vacant) - 0-10 for trailers actually parked without tractors.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on two distinct building faces (SW and NE) - cross-dock layout.
fieldNotes.dropYard: A dedicated marked trailer-storage area runs along the SW dock apron; currently empty.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entry road and large empty paved yard - ample room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long access road from Hwy 78 plus large open yard - deep queuing room.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: St. George / Dorchester County SC is a small rural town; the campus sits in cleared land surrounded by pine forest off a two-lane state highway. Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural setting in pine forest, somewhat isolated from town - cellular coverage could be weaker. Medium-confidence inference, flagged.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~75 acres for the Building A developed parcel (per LoopNet listing 74.91 acres); the full DHL Commerce Park is 125 acres including unbuilt Building B/C pads.
